title: Attack on Titan
synopsis: Humanity lives within massive walled cities to protect themselves from Titans — gigantic humanoid creatures who devour humans. When the walls are breached, young Eren Yeager vows to exterminate all Titans. An epic tale of survival, betrayal, and the complex nature of freedom.

title: Fullmetal Alchemist: Brotherhood
synopsis: Two brothers use alchemy in their quest to find the Philosopher's Stone to restore their bodies after a failed attempt to resurrect their mother. Acclaimed as one of the greatest anime ever made, it weaves themes of sacrifice, redemption, and the bonds of brotherhood.

title: Death Note
synopsis: A high school student discovers a supernatural notebook that kills anyone whose name is written in it. Using it to cleanse the world of criminals, he becomes locked in an intellectual battle with the world's greatest detective L. A masterclass in psychological cat-and-mouse.

title: Demon Slayer
synopsis: After his family is slaughtered by demons and his sister transformed into one, Tanjiro Kamado joins the Demon Slayer Corps to find a cure and avenge his kin. Breathtaking animation by ufotable elevates this tale of perseverance into a visual masterpiece.

title: Steins;Gate
titleJapanese: シュタインズ・ゲート
synopsis: A self-proclaimed mad scientist accidentally discovers a method of sending messages to the past, setting off a chain of unintended consequences. A slow-burn masterpiece that transforms from a quirky comedy into a devastating tragedy about the cost of changing fate.

title: Neon Genesis Evangelion
titleJapanese: 新世紀エヴァンゲリオン
synopsis: In a post-apocalyptic world, a 14-year-old boy is recruited to pilot a giant mecha to fight mysterious beings called Angels. A groundbreaking work that deconstructs the mecha genre while delving deep into depression, loneliness, and the human condition.

title: Hunter x Hunter
synopsis: A young boy embarks on a journey to become a Hunter — an elite member of humanity — to find his missing father. Alongside companions with dark pasts, Gon discovers a world far more complex and brutal than he imagined. The Chimera Ant arc is legendary.

title: Code Geass
titleJapanese: コードギアス 反逆のルルーシュ
synopsis: A banished prince in an alternate dystopian future gains the power of absolute obedience and uses it to lead a rebellion against the ruling Britannian Empire — all while living a double life as a high school student. Chess meets warfare meets tragedy.

title: Vinland Saga
synopsis: Set in the Viking Age, a young warrior seeks revenge for his father's death, but gradually questions whether a life built on violence has any meaning. A profound coming-of-age epic about pacifism, slavery, and what it means to find a true homeland.

title: Jujutsu Kaisen
synopsis: A high school student swallows a cursed object to save his friends and becomes host to the most powerful cursed spirit in history. He must now cooperate with sorcerers to collect all cursed objects before being executed. Stunning animation, memorable characters.

title: Re:Zero
titleJapanese: Re:ゼロから始める異世界生活
synopsis: An ordinary young man is suddenly transported to a fantasy world, only to discover he has the power to reverse death — but at the cost of reliving the same brutal moments over and over. A punishing but deeply emotional isekai that subverts genre expectations.

title: One Punch Man
synopsis: A hero who trained until he could defeat any enemy with a single punch now suffers from the existential crisis of having no challenge. A brilliant parody and deconstruction of the superhero genre with some of the most jaw-dropping animation in anime history.

title: Violet Evergarden
titleJapanese: ヴァイオレット・エヴァーガーデン
synopsis: A former child soldier who lost both arms in war becomes an Auto Memory Doll — a ghostwriter — to understand the final words of the major who raised her: 'I love you.' A visually breathtaking KyoAni masterpiece about grief, healing, and humanity.

title: Your Lie in April
synopsis: A piano prodigy who can no longer hear his own playing meets a free-spirited violinist who reawakens his love for music — and brings both light and devastating grief into his monochrome world. The most beautiful anime about music ever made.

title: Chainsaw Man
synopsis: A broke young devil hunter merges with his devil dog companion Pochita and becomes a hybrid with chainsaw powers, joining a government organization hunting dangerous devils. MAPPA's adaptation is raw, stylish, and relentlessly unpredictable.

title: My Hero Academia
titleJapanese: 僕のヒーローアカデミア
synopsis: In a world where most people have superpowers called Quirks, a boy born without any dreams of becoming the greatest hero. Inheriting power from the greatest hero of all, he enrolls in the top hero school. The next generation shonen epic.

title: Berserk
synopsis: The ultimate dark fantasy manga following Guts, the Black Swordsman, on a quest for revenge against his former friend Griffith who sacrificed their mercenary band for godlike power. Kentaro Miura's magnum opus is the pinnacle of the medium.
author: Kentaro Miura / Studio Gaga

title: Vagabond
synopsis: Based on Eiji Yoshikawa's novel about the legendary swordsman Miyamoto Musashi, Vagabond traces his violent path from a reckless warrior toward enlightenment and the true meaning of 'invincible under heaven.' Takehiko Inoue's artwork is unparalleled.
author: Takehiko Inoue

title: Monster
synopsis: A brilliant Japanese surgeon in Germany saves the life of a boy who grows up to become a serial killer. Consumed by guilt, he abandons his prestigious career to track down the monster he created across post-Cold War Europe. Naoki Urasawa's masterwork.
author: Naoki Urasawa

title: Oyasumi Punpun
synopsis: A coming-of-age story following a boy depicted as a simple bird doodle as he navigates childhood traumas, first love, family dysfunction, and existential despair into adulthood. Asano Inio's most devastating work — not for the faint of heart.
author: Inio Asano

title: Slam Dunk
synopsis: A delinquent with no athletic experience joins his high school basketball team to impress a girl, but discovers a genuine passion and talent for the sport. Takehiko Inoue's revolutionary sports manga that changed the landscape of Japanese basketball forever.
author: Takehiko Inoue

title: Tokyo Ghoul
titleJapanese: 東京喰種トーキョーグール
synopsis: A college student becomes a half-ghoul after a near-fatal encounter and must navigate the brutal world of ghouls who feed on humans, while CCG investigators hunt them. Sui Ishida's original manga is far superior to its anime adaptation.
author: Sui Ishida

title: Nana
synopsis: Two young women named Nana meet on a train to Tokyo and become unlikely roommates — one chasing dreams of punk rock stardom, the other following a boyfriend. A raw and unflinching portrayal of female friendship, ambition, love, and heartbreak.
author: Ai Yazawa

title: Claymore
synopsis: In a medieval world terrorized by shapeshifting monsters called Yoma, half-human half-Yoma warriors known as Claymores are humanity's only defense. Following Clare as she seeks revenge against a powerful awakened being. A criminally underrated dark fantasy.
author: Norihiro Yagi

title: Mob Psycho 100
synopsis: A middle school boy with overwhelming psychic powers suppresses his emotions to avoid destructive outbursts. Working under a fraudulent psychic mentor, Mob slowly learns that emotional honesty matters more than power. ONE's masterpiece of emotional growth.
